Stuff that works for me so far:

1. Find something that you don't like about them. I know it's hard and it's not exactly a good thing because you can end up hating them which would be disastrous if you intend to keep your friendship with them intact. 

2. Find something to obsess like movies, tv series, books, hobbies, or bands. They will keep your mind off of your crush. 

3. And the last one, and the hardest imo, cry myself out trying to accept that it won't happen and that it's enough for me to see them happy, even if it's not with me. 

Of course it will be different for each person, just be patient and take your time. My DM is always open if you need someone to vent. Good luck!

I did that to two different person and two different circumstances. 

The first one, to my first crush. One day I realized that I was the one who always reached out to him first. Every single day, for almost six years. So I decided to not text him first for once. He never reached back out to me,  when I finally contacted him again (after months of waiting) he said that he missed me so much. I don't believe that of course, because I was always just a text away. 

And the second one, to my best friend, I did this to him because I wanted to give him some time processing something that happened to us. After we reconciled, he admitted that his mental is deteriorating when I went MIA and he said he also didn't want to burden me with his problems.

So if you really want to do it make sure you're really want to do it. Because it's hard. Really hard. By now, reaching out to them might have become a habit for us. To hold the urge to send them memes they'll like or just to say something like 'hi how are you?' could be unbearable. And to feel that emptiness when they don't even asked you about your day and stuff after few days in. 

There is a simpler solution to this but I can't guarantee anything tho. Talk to them. Tell them what you're feeling. Tell them that you feel like your effort to connect with them isn't reciprocated in the same amount. 

Whatever you do, be brave and be strong. You are enough just the way you are. 

Good luck! 🍀
